text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments, according to Sheminith (Sheminith). A Psalm of David (beloved). 1 O LORD {YHWH}, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
Be merciful to me, O LORD {YHWH}, for I am frail; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.
My soul is deeply distressed. How long, O LORD {YHWH}, how long?
Turn, O LORD {YHWH}, and deliver my soul; save me because of Your loving devotion.
For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?
I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.
My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.
Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD {YHWH} has heard my weeping.
The LORD {YHWH} has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.
All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.
